entities.name: 3,4-Dihydro-2H-pyran
observations: The first component is decoded as 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran, a tetrahydropyranyl protecting reagent for alcohols.

entities.name: Fluorinated thioether alcohol
observations: The substrate is approximately OCCSc1ccccc1-c1nnc2ccc(F)cn12 and contains a terminal primary alcohol suitable for THP protection.

entities.name: p-Toluenesulfonic acid
observations: p-Toluenesulfonic acid is assigned as the Brønsted-acid catalyst/promoter.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Dichloromethane is assigned as the reaction solvent.

entities.name: THP-protected fluorinated thioether
observations: The matched product is FC=1C=CC=2N(C1)C(=NN2)C2=C(C=CC=C2)SCCOC2OCCCC2, formed by converting HO-CH2-CH2-SAr into the tetrahydropyranyl ether Ar-S-CH2-CH2-O-THP.

entities.name: THP protection of primary alcohol
observations: Acid-catalyzed reaction of the hydroxyethyl thio-substituted fluorinated fused N-heteroarene with 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran gives the corresponding THP ether; the matched record reports 74% yield in dichloromethane.
